definition: ell_R(p) is the lower endpoint of {q:kl(p||q)<=R}, with0<p<1 andR>0. Thus0<q=ell_R(p)<p. Let v=logit(p)-logit(q)>0, r=p-q>0 andP=p(1-p)>0.

exact_identity.proof: Implicit differentiation ofD(p,q)=R gives ell_prime=K and ell_second=(q(1-q)/r)[1/P-2K/(q(1-q))+(p/q^2+(1-p)/(1-q)^2)K^2]. Dividing byK and using p(1-q)^2+(1-p)q^2=P+r^2 gives J=1/(Pv)-2/r+(P+r^2)v/r^2=v+(Pv-r)^2/(Pv r^2). Also q=p/[p+(1-p)e^v], hence Pv/r=v[(1-p)+1/(e^v-1)], which yields the hyperbolic form.

ellipse_reduction.curvature_formula: Let s=sqrt(1-z^2), evaluateK,J atp=p_plus(z), q=ell_R(p). Then L(z)=ell_R(p_plus(z)) satisfies L_second=(K/s^3)[J*s*(B*s-C*z)^2-C].
ellipse_reduction.exact_remaining_inequality: At the model-dependent radiusR*=max_z BernoulliCapacity(A+Bz-C*s,A+Bz+C*s), the desired concavity is exactly J*s*(B*s-C*z)^2<=C for everyz. IfB*s-C*z=0, strict concavity follows immediately.
ellipse_reduction.upper_branch: U(z)=u_R(p_minus(z))=1-ell_R(1-p_minus(z)). Thus U convexity is precisely the same lower-concavity condition for the complemented model(Abar,Bbar,Cbar)=(1-A,-B,C).
ellipse_reduction.status: The reduction is proved. The remaining inequality has not been proved for all physical models, including atR*. This file does not establish the unrestricted reflected-pair conjecture.

radius_nonmonotonicity.claim: For fixedp, J need not increase withR, even when both radii are belowlog(2).
radius_nonmonotonicity.exact_construction: Usep=999/1000 andv=3 or5 exactly, q_v=p/[p+(1-p)exp(v)], R_v=kl(p||q_v). The retained64-digit outward intervals prove0<R_3<R_5<log(2), whileJ_3>J_5>0.
radius_nonmonotonicity.implication: Verifying curvature at a larger radius upper boundU does not by itself verify it atR*, unless an additional justified monotonicity or domination property is available. This counterexample concerns the inverse-KL ratio only, not the physical-ellipse conjecture.

claim_boundary: Analytic simplification and a certified caution about a proof shortcut; no new data, no full all-angle theorem, no finite-cost claim and no SOTA claim.
